subject: Taxes
title: Germany's One-Year Rule
description: Learn Germany's One-Year Rule in one minute.

hook.text: In Germany, hold crypto for one year and your gains are completely tax-free—no matter the amount.

buildup.text: Germany treats crypto as a private asset, not a security.

discovery.text: The one-year rule incentivizes long-term holding. German crypto culture shifted toward patience over trading.

twist.text: In 2022, Germany confirmed that staking and lending rewards don't reset the one-year clock.

climax.text: Germany's approach is the clearest in Europe: hold long, pay nothing. Short-term trading is heavily penalized.

punchline.text: Hold one year, zero tax. Germany rewards patience with total exemption.

quiz.question: How does Germany tax crypto held over one year?
